Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments (CLMS, HDX-MS, and IP-MS) in this study are used for structural characterization and complex stoichiometry of the TAF11/TAF13/TBP assembly rather than for differential expression or perturbation analysis. While the paper describes genetic mutants and cell growth assays, these are orthogonal to the mass spectrometry data provided in the PRIDE dataset (PXD005676), which focuses on the architecture of the complex. Therefore, this is classified as a non-perturbation/structural proteomics study.
